---
title: "About these docs"
subtitle: "How the site is built, and how to report a mismatch."
---

These pages describe how `gh-inbox` and the tools around it are meant to behave. [SPEC.md](https://github.com/rpuncel/efforts-bridge/blob/main/SPEC.md) is the source of truth; this site is the walk-through version of it.

## Reporting a mismatch

1. Read the [overview](index.qmd), then walk each tool page as if setting it up.
2. For each mismatch or change, open one issue on `rpuncel/efforts-bridge` labelled {{< meta facts.label.spec >}}.
3. Each issue is fixed in one pull request that changes both SPEC.md and these docs, so they never drift.
4. Once the implementation lands, anything the code does that the docs don't say (or the reverse) becomes a {{< meta facts.label.spec >}} issue too.

## How the site is built

- It's a [Quarto](https://quarto.org) website in `docs/`, built and deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/docs.yml` on every push to `main`. Pull requests build it but don't deploy.
- Every shared fact lives once in `docs/_partials/`:
  - single values (folder names, marker comments, config key names, times, placeholders) in `_partials/facts.yml`, used inline as `{{{< meta facts.… >}}}`;
  - tables, templates and the example config in `_partials/*.qmd`, pulled in with `{{{< include >}}}`.
- Change a fact there and every page picks it up. Pages never restate a fact by hand.
- Build locally with `quarto render docs`, or preview with `quarto preview docs`.

## Privacy

The repo and this site are public. They use placeholders such as {{< meta facts.ph.host >}}, {{< meta facts.ph.org >}} and {{< meta facts.ph.team_repo >}}; real values live only in your local config.
